title: Chọn nhà hàng còn món trên trang chi tiết
rootCause: The customer detail route originally owned only one restaurant-scoped MenuItem and had no public contract for equivalent items at other restaurants. After the contract was added, the selector was still mounted through a global portal beside the sticky order card and was completely suppressed whenever serviceAt was present, so valid restaurant results could remain invisible on the page.
flow: MenuItem/Recipe/Ingredient/StockItem/Warehouse -> shared serving-variant availability -> MenuItem inventory fields and menuItemLiveState -> customerMenuItemLocations -> food-detail restaurant selector mounted after the dish description -> route reload with the selected restaurant MenuItem -> addCartItem

planned: manual desktop and mobile food-detail review with one closed/out-of-stock and one open/in-stock restaurant
completed: read AGENTS.md, Trellis workflow, ponytail, frontend-design, ui-ux-pro-max and the food-detail design guide
traced persistence, resolver/service, GraphQL operations, food detail navigation and add-cart restaurant scope
replaced the manager-only inventory calculation with a compatibility re-export to one shared variant availability service
made the runtime customer live-state resolver use the same warehouse, recipe variant and inventory calculation
added a public query that finds active public restaurants carrying the same exact dish name or shared code, computes each location stock and removes duplicate restaurant entries
added a food-detail selector that lists every matching restaurant and automatically redirects to an accepting restaurant with verified stock
kept manual restaurant selection, deep links, default serving key and restaurant-scoped cart input aligned
moved the selector portal below the dish description, made it visible even when serviceAt is present, and preserved serviceAt when the customer manually changes restaurant
changed the restaurant collection to a responsive multi-column list with bounded scrolling for long result sets
added focused backend and frontend regression tests and reviewed latest file contents after each write
notRun: Targeted Vitest suites, GraphQL check, conflict check and production build were not run because the GitHub connector does not provide a repository checkout with installed dependencies.
Desktop/mobile visual verification and a real database scenario with multiple restaurant results remain for the local environment.
